messages.text: BL-1670 🎵 in progress — The land step's stray cherry-pick loop aborts the whole replay when a pure-evidence or doc stray conflicts against origin/main's later text - BL-1459's bounced first-round doc on six role branches, and QA's own log-append commit whose content main already carries in full - so every land escalates until it is tolerated (BL-1657, BL-1661, BL-1667, BL-1664 on 2026-09-20): a pure-evidence or doc stray that adds nothing main lacks, or whose conflicting lines main's landed commits last wrote, is superseded, printed as LAND_STRAY_SUPERSEDED, skipped, and the walk continues to its sibling verdicts
